summary: Gaotu Techedu Inc. (NYSE: GOTU) filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, announcing management changes. CFO Shannon Nan Shen resigned effective May 31, 2026, for personal reasons; she will advise for three months post-departure. COO Bin Luo was promoted. The internal replacements: Mike Buqing Xu (Head of Strategy) will oversee capital markets, and Willa Jia Yao (Senior Finance Director) will oversee financial reporting. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine senior management transition, not a forced departure. The filing lacks deal terms.
